intro: Vicious Night Web Spider Venom is a potent natural toxin gathered from the arachnids haunting eastern Tirisfal Glades. The Royal Apothecary Society prizes it for its peculiar ability to carry and preserve historical disease strains, making it a critical reagent in the development of the Forsaken's New Plague.

p: According to research conducted by Apothecary Johaan in Brill, ancient texts chronicle a devastating historical plague that wiped out thousands of victims across northern Lordaeron. Curiously, the contagious agent behind that forgotten outbreak managed to endure over centuries by embedding itself within the venom of the local Night Web spiders. By hunting down the vicious breed lurking in Venomweb Vale south of the Scarlet Monastery, the apothecaries extract this preserved virulence to serve as a vital catalyst in their ongoing alchemical experiments.
